note.note:
I’m ready to create the SOAP clinical note. Please provide the following so I can proceed:

- The full visit transcript (conversation between clinician and patient).
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON from the diagnostic agent.

If helpful, paste them exactly into the placeholders used in your prompt (i.e., between <<< and >>>). Important reminders:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary source of facts.
- Do not include additional clinical facts not present in the transcript or DDx.
- If medications are mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record them as “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If transcript and DDx conflict, I will note “conflict noted.”

Optional but useful:
- Any vitals, physical exam findings, labs/imaging results, or medication lists not in the transcript.
- Clarify whether you want the note for a specific EHR template or patient chart.

When you paste both items I will produce the structured SOAP note per your rules.
